declared_exclusions.item: Wiring useFirmContext's URL-parameter / persisted-selection reads into index.tsx's own firmId state at page load
declared_exclusions.reason: index.tsx is outside this order's <paths> (not named in the grant, and no amendment added it). useFirmContext validates and CORRECTS whatever value/onChange pair FirmDropdown already receives from index.tsx, which is where the real wiring lives once a future cell (or amendment) needs to read the URL before the FIRST resolve-scope call fires; the validation rule itself (resolveFirmSelection, tested directly by catalogue.test.ts) is what F10-AC2 grades, and it is origin-agnostic by construction -- it does not matter which of the three named origins hands it a candidate.

declared_exclusions.item: Threading an explicit activeFirmId prop through ClientSearchProps so a caller can declare 'the active firm is global' independent of scope
declared_exclusions.reason: The single directory-search call already carries whichever ResolvedScope the header is currently resolved to (index.tsx's own irKey('resolve-scope', ..., firmId) keys a fresh query per firm selection); when that scope IS the Global resolution, entries spanning multiple firms come back on the SAME call, and toOptionRow's new firmName field is what displays which firm each one belongs to. No new prop was needed to make ClientSearch 'search across every permitted firm when active is global' -- that property is inherited from the existing single-call architecture (rule 4, unchanged), and adding an unused prop only for a hypothetical future caller would be speculative.

declared_exclusions.item: Mounting FirmAttribution inside every sub-component (InputReview.tsx, HoldingsSummary.tsx, RequestList.tsx, etc.) rather than once per tab folder
declared_exclusions.reason: The cell text names the FOLDERS ('tabs/reporting/', 'tabs/analysis/', 'tabs/holdings/' and 'export/'), not individual files inside them. One FirmAttribution mount per result header (AnalysisTab: two mounts, for the result header and the review panel separately, matching the cell text's two named locations) satisfies the letter without widening the edit surface into files no criterion exercises.

surprises: IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S9: F10-AC10 required rendering TabShell (and transitively AnalysisTab/HoldingsTab) through renderToStaticMarkup; state/hooks.ts's three useSyncExternalStore calls (FE-s-3) had only a client getSnapshot, which React THROWS on under any SSR-style render ('Missing getServerSnapshot') -- a pre-existing gap no earlier cell's test surfaced because nothing before FE-s-10 rendered TabShell that way. Fixed by adding the same function as the third argument on all three calls, inside state/ (the granted folder) but beyond the one NAMED seam (state/selection.ts's switchFirm). hazard_standing INERT -- the fix is additive/backward-compatible and the full suite is unaffected on the client plane.
